summary: This clinical trial compares a stomach-shrinking procedure called Endoscopic Radial Compression Gastroplasty (ERCG) with intensive lifestyle changes for adults who gained weight back after stopping certain weight-loss drugs. The study aims to enroll 60 participants to see how well these approaches help manage weight regain. The status of this trial is Not yet recruiting.
